question: Find the name and artist of the card with the highest EDHRec rank (i.e., lowest numerical edhrecRank value) that was illustrated by an artist who has also created at least one card with a content warning, and that belongs to a set which has a Japanese translation.

prediction.sql:
SELECT c."XCL_049", c."XCL_002"
FROM cards AS c
WHERE c."XCL_014" IS NOT NULL
  AND c."XCL_002" IN (
    SELECT c2."XCL_002"
    FROM cards AS c2
    WHERE c2."XCL_064" IS NOT NULL
  )
  AND c."XCL_063" IN (
    SELECT st."XCL_093"
    FROM set_translations AS st
    WHERE st."XCL_092" = 'Japanese'
  )
ORDER BY c."XCL_014" ASC
LIMIT 1

entity_grain_realization.pre_realization_sql:
SELECT c."XCL_049", c."XCL_002"
FROM cards AS c
WHERE c."XCL_014" IS NOT NULL
  AND c."XCL_002" IN (
    SELECT c2."XCL_002"
    FROM cards AS c2
    WHERE c2."XCL_064" IS NOT NULL
  )
  AND c."XCL_063" IN (
    SELECT st."XCL_093"
    FROM set_translations AS st
    WHERE st."XCL_092" = 'Japanese'
  )
ORDER BY c."XCL_014" ASC
LIMIT 1

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_049", T1."XCL_002"
FROM cards AS T1
INNER JOIN set_translations AS T2 ON T2."XCL_093" = T1."XCL_063"
WHERE T2."XCL_092" = 'Japanese'
  AND T1."XCL_014" IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM cards AS T3
    WHERE T3."XCL_002" = T1."XCL_002"
      AND T3."XCL_012" IS NOT NULL
      AND T3."XCL_012" != ''
  )
ORDER BY T1."XCL_014" ASC
LIMIT 1
